Research Experience

Nov 2025 – Sep 2026

BAMOR — Bamboo Actuated Morphology for Operative Response

UCL Bartlett School of Architecture, RC2 – Soft Robotic Architecture

  • Developed a human-scale, deployable bamboo–textile structure integrating natural material behaviour, computational design and robotic actuation.
  • Built a real-time interaction workflow using Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, aubio and ROS, translating body posture and musical rhythm into adaptive structural movement.
  • Explored co-embodiment through human–machine interaction, examining how responsive systems can participate in spatial experience and performance.
Jun 2024 – Oct 2024

Modular Moon Village Concept Design for Long-term Habitation in Lava Tube

Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University – Undergraduate Research Fellowship

  • Conducted a systematic literature review on architectural and energy strategies for extreme extraterrestrial environments.
  • Developed a design-research framework translating environmental constraints into spatial systems.

Research Outcomes:

  • Published paper in the 75th International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2024)
  • Project presented at the International Conference on Space Habitation and Exploitation 2024
  • Second Prize, Australian Space Architecture Challenge 2025
Jun 2023 – Sep 2023

Education-led Urban Regeneration

Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University – Undergraduate Research Fellowship
